name: Lost Clan Relic
description: An ancient ceremonial relic from a forgotten warrior dynasty, radiating unbounded ancestral prestige.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of an ancient ornamental samurai clan heirloom amulet emblem with crossed sacred blades and imperial sun disc centerpiece. Centered completely inside a giant solid flat bright crimson red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Pristine vector geometry, duotone black and crimson, no 3D rendering, no text, no watermark.
